title: An email style save writes only the emailStyle preference key

source.ref: Space function scan 2026-11-18, a whole-blob writer LIVE-2347's residual named (lib/spaces/email-style-actions.ts)

detail: The Email style settings surface (setSpaceEmailStyle) read spaces.preferences, built the next bag with nextEmailStylePreferences and wrote the whole object back with .update({ preferences }). A save there landing beside a save from another console (a Spotlight publish, a website editor stub, a menu save) could undo it. Fixed: the action diffs the next bag against the fresh read (lib/spaces/preferences-patch.ts preferencesPatch) and sends only the changed key through patchSpacePreferences (set_space_preferences, SCAN-833): emailStyle with its sanitized value, or null to clear it. An unchanged style writes nothing and still returns ok. Gating, sanitizing, revalidation and the failure message are unchanged. No migration. Residual: two email-style saves from different tabs still race inside the emailStyle key (last write wins), as for LIVE-2347.

verify.note: Fails while lib/spaces/email-style-actions.ts replaces the whole preferences blob instead of sending a key-scoped patch. Behavior test: lib/spaces/email-style-actions.test.ts.
